items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What is it, Gambinos? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] I never was here.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was in a band. I took Charlie's place in a band. Oh, Charlie Duke? Charlie Duke. Charlie Duke. I took his place. I came in. I was out there at the plaza and heard him out there. Yeah, when I took his place, I came in at that Charlie level. I took his place. Where? Across the length of it, you know, on Canal Boulevard.
I never was here. You know where the tracks are?
